note: Positive TestRFC1350TimeoutEndsTheTransferOfAGonePeer: with no ACK, block 1 must arrive exactly maxRetransmit+1 times then silence past a full ackTimeout+2 s (red on retransmitting forever or on no timeout), and a one-slot server must then serve a new RRQ (red if the failed transfer never releases its slot). Negative TestRFC1350TimeoutThenACKContinuesTheTransfer: an ACK after one timeout-driven retransmission continues to block 2 (red on treating the first timeout as fatal). The old single-polarity test-cost argument is gone from the row.
